name: @theethosteam/sheets-mcp

tools.name: sheets_whoami
tools.description: Which Google account these credentials belong to, plus the configured default spreadsheet. Start here when something 403s.

tools.name: list_spreadsheets
tools.description: Find spreadsheets in Drive by name (or any Drive query). The way to turn 'the Q3 budget sheet' into a spreadsheet ID.

tools.name: get_spreadsheet
tools.description: Spreadsheet metadata: every tab (title + sheetId + size), named ranges, locale. Metadata only unless includeGridData — full grid data can be enormous.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

ranges.description: Limit grid data to these A1 ranges.

includeGridData.description: Include cell values AND formatting. Large.

tools.name: list_sheets
tools.description: Just the tabs in a spreadsheet: title, sheetId, index, row/column counts.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

tools.name: read_range
tools.description: Read cell values as a 2-D array. valueRenderOption FORMULA returns formulas instead of results; UNFORMATTED_VALUE returns raw numbers/dates.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

range.description: A1 range, e.g. "A1:D50", "A:A", "2:10", or fully qualified "Invoices!A1:D50". Omit for the whole tab.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

tools.name: read_ranges
tools.description: Read several ranges in ONE call (values.batchGet). Use this instead of looping read_range.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

tools.name: export_csv
tools.description: Read a range and return it as CSV text — the compact form to hand a human or paste elsewhere.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

range.description: A1 range, e.g. "A1:D50", "A:A", "2:10", or fully qualified "Invoices!A1:D50". Omit for the whole tab.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

tools.name: write_range
tools.description: Overwrite a range with a 2-D array of values. valueInputOption USER_ENTERED (default) parses formulas, dates and currency exactly like typing does; RAW stores literal strings.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

range.description: A1 range, e.g. "A1:D50", "A:A", "2:10", or fully qualified "Invoices!A1:D50". Omit for the whole tab.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

tools.name: write_ranges
tools.description: Write several ranges in ONE call (values.batchUpdate). Each entry needs a qualified range and its values.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

tools.name: append_rows
tools.description: Append rows after the last row of the table. INSERT_ROWS (default) shifts anything below down instead of overwriting it — the safe choice for logs and ledgers.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

range.description: A1 range, e.g. "A1:D50", "A:A", "2:10", or fully qualified "Invoices!A1:D50". Omit for the whole tab.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

tools.name: clear_range
tools.description: Delete the VALUES in a range (formatting survives). DESTRUCTIVE — requires confirm:true.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

range.description: A1 range, e.g. "A1:D50", "A:A", "2:10", or fully qualified "Invoices!A1:D50". Omit for the whole tab.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

confirm.description: Must be true — this operation destroys data or grants access.

tools.name: create_spreadsheet
tools.description: Create a new spreadsheet, optionally with named tabs and dropped straight into a Drive folder.

folderId.description: Drive folder to file it under.

tools.name: share_spreadsheet
tools.description: Grant access to a person, a domain, or anyone with the link. OUTWARD-FACING — requires confirm:true. notify:true emails them.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

type.description: user (default when email given) | group | domain | anyone

confirm.description: Must be true — this operation destroys data or grants access.

tools.name: list_permissions
tools.description: Who currently has access to a spreadsheet, and at what role.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

tools.name: move_spreadsheet
tools.description: Move a spreadsheet into a Drive folder (replaces its current parents).

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

tools.name: trash_spreadsheet
tools.description: Move the whole spreadsheet to Drive trash. DESTRUCTIVE — requires confirm:true. Recoverable for 30 days.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

confirm.description: Must be true — this operation destroys data or grants access.

tools.name: add_sheet
tools.description: Add a tab to a spreadsheet.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

tools.name: delete_sheet
tools.description: Delete a tab and everything on it. DESTRUCTIVE — requires confirm:true.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

confirm.description: Must be true — this operation destroys data or grants access.

tools.name: duplicate_sheet
tools.description: Copy a tab within the same spreadsheet — the safe way to snapshot before a bulk edit.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

tools.name: update_sheet_properties
tools.description: Rename / reorder / hide a tab, set its colour, freeze header rows or columns, resize the grid.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

frozenRowCount.description: Freeze this many rows at the top.

tools.name: copy_sheet_to
tools.description: Copy a tab into a DIFFERENT spreadsheet.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

tools.name: insert_rows_or_columns
tools.description: Insert blank rows or columns. startIndex is 1-BASED and matches the row/column numbers shown in the UI.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

startIndex.description: 1-based position to insert at (row 5 means row 5).

inheritFromBefore.description: Copy formatting from the row/column above.

tools.name: delete_rows_or_columns
tools.description: Delete rows or columns. 1-BASED and INCLUSIVE (startIndex 5, endIndex 7 deletes rows 5,6,7). DESTRUCTIVE — requires confirm:true.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

confirm.description: Must be true — this operation destroys data or grants access.

tools.name: auto_resize
tools.description: Auto-fit column widths (or row heights) to their contents.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

tools.name: sort_range
tools.description: Sort a range. Give `column` (a letter) for the simple case, or full sortSpecs for multi-key sorts. Exclude the header row from the range.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

range.description: A1 range, e.g. "A1:D50", "A:A", "2:10", or fully qualified "Invoices!A1:D50". Omit for the whole tab.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

column.description: Column letter to sort by, e.g. "C".

tools.name: format_cells
tools.description: Style a range: bold/italic, font size, text and background colour (hex), alignment, wrapping, number format. ADDITIVE — only the properties you pass are touched.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

range.description: A1 range, e.g. "A1:D50", "A:A", "2:10", or fully qualified "Invoices!A1:D50". Omit for the whole tab.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

format.description: Raw CellFormat for anything not covered above (borders, padding…).

tools.name: merge_cells
tools.description: Merge a range into one cell, or unmerge it with unmerge:true.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

range.description: A1 range, e.g. "A1:D50", "A:A", "2:10", or fully qualified "Invoices!A1:D50". Omit for the whole tab.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

tools.name: set_data_validation
tools.description: Add a dropdown or validation rule to a range. Pass `values` for a simple dropdown, or a full `rule` for anything else.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

range.description: A1 range, e.g. "A1:D50", "A:A", "2:10", or fully qualified "Invoices!A1:D50". Omit for the whole tab.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

tools.name: add_conditional_format
tools.description: Add a conditional-formatting rule to a range (colour scales, highlight-if rules).

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

range.description: A1 range, e.g. "A1:D50", "A:A", "2:10", or fully qualified "Invoices!A1:D50". Omit for the whole tab.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

tools.name: find_replace
tools.description: Find and replace across a range, a tab, or the whole spreadsheet. Supports regex. BULK MUTATION — requires confirm:true.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

range.description: A1 range, e.g. "A1:D50", "A:A", "2:10", or fully qualified "Invoices!A1:D50". Omit for the whole tab.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

confirm.description: Must be true — this operation destroys data or grants access.

tools.name: add_named_range
tools.description: Name a range so formulas and later calls can refer to it by name.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

range.description: A1 range, e.g. "A1:D50", "A:A", "2:10", or fully qualified "Invoices!A1:D50". Omit for the whole tab.

sheet.description: Tab title (e.g. "Invoices") or numeric sheetId. Defaults to the first tab.

tools.name: delete_named_range
tools.description: Remove a named range by name. DESTRUCTIVE — requires confirm:true (formulas referencing it will break).

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

confirm.description: Must be true — this operation destroys data or grants access.

tools.name: batch_update
tools.description: The FULL Sheets API power tool: send any spreadsheets.batchUpdate requests — charts, pivot tables, banding, protected ranges, filter views, developer metadata, borders, dimension groups. Requests apply atomically in order. Destructive request types (deleteSheet, deleteDimension, cutPaste…) require confirm:true. GridRange indices here are 0-based and END-EXCLUSIVE.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID or full Google Sheets URL. Defaults to SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID.

confirm.description: Must be true — this operation destroys data or grants access.

tools.name: raw
tools.description: Call ANY Sheets method by dotted path, e.g. 'spreadsheets.values.get', 'spreadsheets.developerMetadata.search', 'spreadsheets.getByDataFilter'. Prefix with 'drive:' for Drive, e.g. 'drive:files.list'. params is the request object.
